tools.name: search_websites
tools.description: Search the DesignMD Pro library of website design systems by name, domain, description or category. Returns slugs plus a summary (primary color, fonts, token counts, Pro/locked status). Pass a slug to get_design_md for the full DESIGN.md.

tools.name: get_design_md
tools.description: Get a website's DESIGN.md design-system spec by slug. Use `sections` to fetch only the headings you need (response lists availableSections), and format `json` for structured tokens instead of Markdown. `version` selects a historical revision (see list_revisions). Pro sites return prose plus a token

tools.name: list_revisions
tools.description: List the revision history of a website's DESIGN.md (newest first): version, date, changelog and token counts. Pass a version to get_design_md to read that revision.

tools.name: extract-color-palette
tools.description: Extract a frequency-ranked, role-classified color palette from a website by statically analyzing its HTML and CSS. Returns ranked colors (hex/rgb/hsl, roles, usage counts), grouped palette roles (primary/accents/neutrals/surfaces/texts), resolved CSS custom properties, and a separate dark-scheme pal

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_websites" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
